name: RepairJob
description: Private appliance-repair job draft owned by a coordinator. Operator-entered preparation data only; no call evidence or customer-confirmed results.

demo_marker.description: Server-controlled marker for the one authorized RepairReady demonstration; empty for ordinary jobs

customer_name.description: Customer full name as entered by the coordinator

appliance_type.description: Appliance category: washing_machine, dryer, dishwasher, refrigerator, oven_range, or other

reported_problem.description: Problem description as reported to the coordinator

symptom_timing.description: When the symptom occurs, if known

visit_note.description: Existing appointment or visit notes. Free text, not a booking system.

access_notes.description: Access, parking, pets, or workspace notes. Never store alarm or entry codes.
